meta.title: HomeTab — Family Manager

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Sees the dashboard, transactions, reports and goals. Changes nothing.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Like a viewer, and can also add, import and edit transactions. Cannot delete them.

admin.label: Administrator
admin.description: Can do everything: settings, users, goals and deleting transactions.
